subject: Processing governance evidence request and Art.28/30 checkpoints
messages:
From: dp@bancnord.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@datacorp.com
Date: 2027-05-30T08:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and onboarding checklist for processors, BancNord needs a compact evidence packet covering:

- Confirmed list of subprocessors used for production inference and backups (including region and retention).
- Art.28/30 processing ledger or similar record of processing activities (we use this for our DPIA audit).
- A short summary of DPIA support you can provide (timelines + point of contact).
- Any standard contractual clauses or transfer safeguards you rely on for EU->US transfers.

Can you send an initial packet by EOD Wednesday (CEST)? Also let us know if you'll need an NDA/DP Addendum signed first — we can reciprocate quickly if needed.

Appreciate it,
Julien Picard
VP Risk & Compliance
BancNord

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: dp@bancnord.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Julien,

Thanks — we can assemble an evidence packet. Initial notes and plan below. Looping in Kim (Legal) for contractual/transfer language.

What we'll deliver by Wednesday (CEST):
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV): production inference, logging, backups, telemetry processors; region and role included.
- Art.28/30 ledger (spreadsheet): processing activities mapping to our DPA clauses.
- DPIA support summary (PDF): how we can support your internal DPIA, typical timelines (2–3 weeks for requested artifacts + 1 week for clarifications).
- Links to our standard DPA and SCC references.

A couple quick asks from our side to speed this release:
1) Please confirm the primary contact for your DPIA team (name + email) so we can tailor the summary.
2) If you need attestations on infra residency for specific data classes, call that out now.

We will include an exportable evidence bundle (Drive link + CSV/Excel + PDFs). I will seat Marcus on technical details for the subprocessor list.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: dp@bancnord.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Julien / Naomi,

We can provide our standard DPA (including Art.28 obligations) and reference the SCCs we rely on for transfers. A few legal notes:
- We can commit to Art.28 subprocessor obligations and notify you of new subprocessors per the DPA timeline.
- For transfers we use a combination of SCCs + documented technical controls; we will attach the transfer assurance summary.

I'll attach the DPA excerpt and transfer summary in the evidence bundle. If BancNord requires contract redlines, please indicate which clauses are negotiable and the primary contact for procurement/legal so we can coordinate.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment stub: redwood_dpa_excerpt.pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: dp@bancnord.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Hi Julien,

Attaching the technical inventory we promised. High-level highlights:
- Subprocessors: inference-hosting (Redwood Dedicated), metrics/observability (third-party A), backups (third-party B), model artifacts store (internal). Regions indicated per entry.
- Retention defaults: inference logs 30 days (configurable), billing metadata 24 months, backups retained per customer-specific policy.
- We record operational activities in an Art.30-style ledger that maps endpoints to processing categories.

Attachments included: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_v3.csv, art28-30_processing_ledger.xlsx, redwood_dpia_summary.pdf

If you want a walkthrough call to go through the ledger and map to your DPIA controls, I'm available Thursday afternoon CEST.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_v3.csv, art28-30_processing_ledger.xlsx, redwood_dpia_summary.pdf)

From: dp@bancnord.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T16:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Naomi / Kim / Marcus,

Received — thank you, this is very helpful and close to what our DPIA team needs. A couple follow-ups before we close the item:
- Can you confirm whether any subprocessors outside the EU process personal data at-rest for BancNord data? The CSV shows regions but we'd like explicit confirmation.
- The ledger is comprehensive; can the spreadsheet be exported to a PDF-friendly narrative for our audit pack? If you can produce a 2–3 page narrative referencing key rows that would be ideal.
- We will route contract redlines to procurement next week if any are needed. For now, please share the DocuSign link for the DPA we can sign.

Primary DPIA contact: Anne-Marie Sorel (anne.sorel@bancnord.com) — she'll reach out if they need more technical clarifications.

Best regards,
Julien Picard
VP Risk & Compliance
BancNord
(related link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/evidence-pack-BancNord)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: dp@bancnord.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of processing & Art.28/30 ledger for onboarding

Julien/Anne-Marie,

Quick answers:
- Explicit confirmation: No subprocessors outside the EU/US process personal data at-rest for BancNord in the default onboarding configuration. Where a customer requires EU-only residency we can deploy in EU-only regions — we will mark those rows in the CSV as EU-residency.
- Narrative export: Yes, we'll produce a 2–3 page narrative that ties ledger rows to Art.28 controls and call it out for your audit pack. Marcus will draft it and Kim will review.
- DocuSign: attaching the DPA signing link now: https://app.docusign.com/doc12345/sign

We will follow up with the narrative by Friday EOD CEST and copy Anne-Marie. Thanks for the clear asks.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood_dpa_summary.pdf, redwood_subprocessor_inventory_v3.csv)
